description: Fully managed agents that autonomously plan and execute tasks using foundation models, APIs, and knowledge bases

justification.D_rationale: D=1: Data processed on AWS infrastructure with contractual controls (BAA available). Training data of underlying models (Claude, Llama, etc.) controlled by model providers, not AWS or the customer.
justification.T_rationale: T=2: Agent orchestration logic is visible to the developer. Underlying foundation model behavior is opaque (especially for third-party models hosted on Bedrock).
justification.A_rationale: A=2: Agents autonomously plan multi-step workflows, invoke APIs and tools, maintain session state, and execute actions based on reasoning.

edge_case_notes: Classification is for the agent deployment as a whole. Individual foundation model API calls within the agent would be Tier B in isolation.
